accounting_rules: November publication date does not become attack date.
More than 115 damaging strike incidents across 26 locations are not 115 destroyed assets.
A damaged facility is not a destroyed base; hangar damage does not prove aircraft damaged inside.
Named site-level and dated photo observations qualify BDA even if precise missile dates and total operational effect are unknown.
Do not double count Washington Post 2026-05-06 and prior AP March imagery.
Qualify any new named site (Jabal ad Dukhan) through source registry and the canonical location / facility authority path; no fabricated map point.
